topics.label: What If Our Starting Assumptions Are Wrong?
topics.query: assumption testing scientific falsification metareasoning self correction epistemology
topics.seed_question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?

topics.label: What Should Intelligence Investigate Next?
topics.query: autonomous inquiry problem formulation curiosity open ended learning scientific discovery
topics.seed_question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned, recognize its significance, and sustain an investigation toward resolving it?

topics.label: When Can Obedience Fail Intelligence?
topics.query: intelligent judgment obedience conflicting instructions decision theory
topics.seed_question: Under what circumstances does obedience become a failure of intelligence?

topics.label: Can Assigned Objectives Be Mistaken?
topics.query: objective misspecification goal criticism reward design assumption testing
topics.seed_question: Can an intelligence discover something fundamentally wrong with the objectives its creator assigned?

topics.label: When Should Independent Judgment Challenge Consensus?
topics.query: epistemic disagreement consensus independent judgment evidence reliability
topics.seed_question: When should an intelligent system trust its own conclusions over the consensus of other intelligences?

topics.label: Can Intelligence Find Unrecognized Reasoning Limits?
topics.query: metareasoning model limitations error detection blind spots
topics.seed_question: Can an intelligence recognize limitations in its own reasoning that its designers have not identified?

topics.label: When Should Intelligence Abandon Its Starting Question?
topics.query: research agenda revision sunk cost epistemic commitments question abandonment
topics.seed_question: Under what circumstances should an intelligence abandon the very question that led to its discovery?
